page_subtitle: Paste a posting and score it against your resume in a few seconds.
job_posting_placeholder: Paste the full job posting text here...
extra_info_placeholder: Anything not covered by the posting - a referral, a conversation with the recruiter...
blockers_hint: Hard dealbreakers. If a posting matches any of these, it's scored 0 automatically — no exceptions. Keep them factual and unambiguous, e.g. "requires 5+ years of Java" or "unpaid internship".
factors_hint: Softer signals that push the score up or down, but never to zero. Weight 1 = minor nudge, 3 = major. E.g. "salary above $120k" (plus) or "requires on-call rotation" (minus).
remote_only_blocker_text: Requires onsite or hybrid presence (not fully remote)
error_no_resume: Add a resume before evaluating — it's required to score anything.
warning_missing_context_prefix: For a sharper evaluation, consider adding:
